assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is documented in the clinical indication note.
The procedure is coded with CPT 93229.
The diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9 support the medical necessity of this diagnostic procedure.
The payer's denial is under CO-197.
The denial is based on the absence of precertification.
The service was medically necessary at the time it was rendered.
